description: Łaziska Górne: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Łaziska Górne. Coverage: Łaziska Górne. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Łaziska Górne: Infrastruktura rowerowa: ścieżki rowerowe; Łaziska Górne: Infrastruktura rowerowa: dodatkowa infrastruktura rower; Łaziska Górne: Decyzje na zajęcie pasa drogowego; Łaziska Górne: Decyzje na lokalizację w pasie drogowym innych urządzeń. Formats seen: XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
